title: one line of code, one flagship hero

hook.visual: pure black. a green-on-black terminal line is typed at 4x speed and the final key hard-cuts into a full-bleed hero with a slow type reveal.

shots.visual: terminal: `$ ship hero --cinematic` typed, enter, white flash frame.
shots.audio: key clicks, sub hit on enter

shots.visual: the hero resolves: oversized lowercase headline reveals line by line on a dark gradient, 600 ms ease-out.
split screen: editor (left) shows the gsap timeline, site (right) scrubs as the cursor drags the playhead.
scroll continues: section transitions with masked kinetic type, devtools fps meter steady.
end card, centered, hairline rule: wordmark and handle.

audio_direction: minimal electronic, 90-100 bpm, one riser; no voiceover. a licensed or royalty-free track from the instagram audio library.

title: same content, two builds

hook.visual: vertical split, same page scrolling at the same speed: left stutters and snaps, right glides with choreographed type.

shots.visual: hard split at frame 1; left jitters, right is silky. a thin vertical hairline divides them.
shots.audio: glitchy tick left, clean tone right (panned)

shots.visual: both scroll the hero: left fades in late with layout shift, right reveals type line by line with a mask.
hover and cursor details: left cursor is default, right has a magnetic cta and a soft spotlight.
devtools overlay: lighthouse-style scores animate, right side fills green. (use measured numbers from the real demo only.)
left half fades to black, right expands full-width; end card.

audio_direction: dry, minimal; sound design carries the contrast (left rough, right clean).

title: scroll is the story

hook.visual: a single kinetic-type word explodes into letters that fly into a 3d scene; the camera starts moving on frame 1.

shots.visual: kinetic type: 'scroll' letters scatter and reassemble into the product object in 3d.
one continuous scroll: object rotates, camera dollies, headline lines mask in and out.
picture-in-picture: code editor with scrolltrigger `scrub: true`; the numbers move as the page moves.
section cuts: pricing, proof, cta; each enters with a distinct but related motion language.
pull back to a phone mockup; end card on dark.

audio_direction: cinematic minimal; a single bass hit on the hook, no melody until second 7.
